scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, methodical investigation with strong evidence citations and correct root-cause identification. Cross-checked per-TFM assembly versions as requested. Weaknesses: the App.config XML was never actually read (concluded by inference), and the proposed fix emphasizes disabling AutoGenerateBindingRedirects over the cleaner primary fix of removing the hardcoded redirect.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 for System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource in DeviceConfigClient, net8.0
Traced AppConfigFile into RAR for all TFMs
Explained RAR unification to 10.0.0.3 conflicting with 10.0.0.0
Noted misleading error message / redirect artifact
Proposed removing hardcoded binding redirect, noting AutoGenerateBindingRedirects handles net472
